name: cache-gauge
description: One line above the prompt: how long the prompt cache stays warm, what letting it go cold costs, and how close the context is to compaction; warns 1 min before the cache goes cold, optionally with a countdown clip in the last 15 s

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto reads Claude Code's own controls (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H) and assumes 5m when none is set; 5m or 1h overrides that

position.title: Position
position.description: above: the full gauge in a band above the prompt; hint: warm and ctx only, at the end of the hint line under the prompt

hintColor.title: Hint colour
hintColor.description: on: with position hint, the gauge draws the whole hint line itself so it can be yellow in the last minute and red when cold; another mod's hint handler running after it is skipped

alarm.title: Cache-ending alarm
alarm.description: notify: a notification at 1 min before the idle cache goes cold, updated at 15 s and when cold; countdown: that, plus a tense 15 s clip from 15 s left; off: neither

alarmSound.title: Alarm sound file
alarmSound.description: Absolute path to your own mp3, wav, m4a or aiff (4 MiB at most) to play in place of the bundled clip; empty uses the bundled one
